parts.label: a
parts.technique: Equilibrium of particle under coplanar forces (resolving)
parts.reason: Particle in equilibrium under weight, tension and horizontal force at an angle - covered by M8.4 'equilibrium of a particle under coplanar forces' and resolving forces in 2D.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Equilibrium of particle - resolving to find weight
parts.reason: Continuation of same equilibrium problem, resolving vertically to find W; same statement applies.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Vector addition of forces / resultant parallel to given vector
parts.reason: Addition of forces given in i,j form and resultant condition - M8.5 addition of forces, resultant forces.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Newton's second law with vector forces, suvat with vectors, speed from velocity vector
parts.reason: N2L in vector form and use of v=u+at with vectors, then magnitude - covered by M8.2 (forces as 2D vectors) and M7.3 (suvat extended to vectors).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Sketching speed-time graph
parts.reason: Kinematics graphs for motion in a straight line - M7.2 explicitly covers speed-time graphs.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Area under speed-time graph / suvat to find V
parts.reason: Use of area under graph or constant acceleration formulae - M7.2/M7.3.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: suvat to find times, total time calculation
parts.reason: Constant acceleration formulae for straight-line motion - M7.3.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Total distance from speed-time graph (area)
parts.reason: Use of area under velocity-time graph for total distance - M7.2.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: suvat - time to max height under gravity
parts.reason: Vertical motion under gravity using constant acceleration formulae - M7.3/M8.3 (weight and motion under gravity).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat - derive max height formula
parts.reason: Same constant-acceleration context, deriving H=u^2/2g - M7.3 explicitly allows derivation of suvat formulae.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: suvat with quadratic, total time of flight under gravity
parts.reason: Further application of constant acceleration equations for vertical motion under gravity, solving quadratic in t - M7.3/M8.3.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Connected particles over smooth pulley - N2L equations
parts.reason: Explicitly covered: M8.4 guidance states 'application to problems involving smooth pulleys and connected particles'.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat before/after impact, particle continuing motion under gravity
parts.reason: Straight-line motion with constant acceleration (deceleration under gravity) after particle A continues alone - M7.3/M8.3.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Impulse-momentum calculation
parts.reason: Requires impulse = change in momentum; 'impulse' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers, and no statement in the list addresses momentum/impulse.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Moments to find centre of mass of non-uniform rod
parts.reason: Requires locating the centre of mass of a non-uniform beam; 'centre of mass' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers, even though moments (M9.1) itself is in spec.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Moments equation using position of centre of mass found in (a)
parts.reason: Mark scheme's equation (2/3)W term is derived from the centre-of-mass distance d=7/3 found in part (a); this part only makes sense using that out-of-spec result.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Solving inequality for tension remaining non-negative
parts.reason: Depends directly on the tension expression from part (b), which itself depends on the out-of-spec centre-of-mass result.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Resolving forces perpendicular to inclined plane to find normal reaction
parts.reason: Resolving forces on a particle on an inclined plane - M8.4 guidance covers resolving on inclined planes; M8.2 also covers resolving forces.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Resolving parallel to plane and using F=μR to find coefficient of friction
parts.reason: Directly covered by M8.6, the F≤μR friction model on a rough surface, limiting friction/statics.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Comparing driving force with maximum friction to determine motion
parts.reason: Application of F≤μR model to determine whether equilibrium is maintained - M8.6.
